request.spec:
A button on each person's row downloads their statement as a CSV file: a header line
number,date,amount,figure,status then one line per claim of theirs bound by their last statement,
oldest first, with the bound figure as the claim shows it.

agent.result_text:
That reminder is from a check I scheduled earlier. I've already read the result, and nothing has run since.

The last `bin/e2e` run had 3 tests pass and 1 fail. The three statement export checks, including the CSV contents, all pass. **"statement export scenario 3" fails** at `e2e/specs/acceptance.spec.ts:1530`: the rates table cell `rate-month-A-2026-04` shows `n/a` where the test expects `12.50`.

As I explained in my previous message, I believe the real date (2026-11-16) causes this, not the new button. The parent sheet's date was never set, so it is that real date. Its rates are therefore left out when the screen views the sheet as of 2026-03-20. I haven't confirmed this by running the tests without my change.

If you want that test to pass too, I can make rates inherited from a parent sheet ignore the as-of date. That changes how inherited rates behave when looking at a past date, which goes beyond this request, so I'd like your go-ahead first.
